about: Pashto narration for The Lost Doll, laid over the pages and pictures of the English Curious Reader book TheLostDollEnLv4. Page numbers are body indexes of the converted English book (0 = title page). Text is taken from the sentence recordings' file names (leading spaces and zero-width spaces removed). Where an English page holds two or three sentences that were recorded separately (question + 'Abi asks the ...', animal sound + '... said', 'the dog found the doll'), 'audio' lists those recordings in story order and align.py joins them. The question 'زما لنزکه چیرته ده؟' has three takes; plain is used on page 10, '2' on page 12, '_' on page 14. 'link' lists the Pashto words that trigger the page's picture (replacing the English glow hotspots). The Pashto recordings say لنزکه for doll; the silent Digital Library book TheLostDollPashto uses نانځکه and a different wording, so its text is not used.
